gates.title: Whole target design and independent review
gates.closure: Current domain/schema/operation/acceptance/packet contracts resolve all reviewed design findings; independent losslessness and whole-plan reviews pass; no substantive open design gap.
gates.review_reason: The 2026-10-14 fix wave changed schema, architecture, catalogs, acceptance cases, package scope, workflow and design handoff inputs. Prior fingerprints are historical provenance; review the corrected current inputs independently.

gates.title: Implementation kickoff
gates.closure: Separate explicit implementation authorization for the reviewed frozen version. Package state is recorded only in docs/build-progress.json.

gates.title: Concrete paid spending
gates.closure: Approve itemized tiers/usage/low-expected-high monthly envelope and recovery/operator costs before any subscription or usage commitment. No vendor/destination re-vote.

gates.title: Merged development workflow
gates.closure: The merged source is received and pinned. Adapt it to the current standalone context/catalog, approval, safe feedback, dependency, final-head evidence and progress contracts; independently review the integration before workflow execution. Preserve the supplied severity/complexity rubric. Install the real qualified runner and authenticated Intent identity/review receipt adapter; independently review its public verification key and keep the signing key outside agent/worktree access. Configure and verify the main repository remote and required protection. Through one owner-reviewed bootstrap commit, switch evf.config.json from tooling-only verification to the qualified application runner and install the approved first-task proof plans and stack wiring. Independently prove the bootstrap before application workflow execution; simulated local tooling receipts cannot close this gate.

gates.title: Authorized environment setup, with backup setup before customer data
gates.closure: Actual project/repository IDs, scoped ordinary credentials and approved privacy settings are configured only under applicable authorization. During the build, use Neon and Tigris native seven-day history. Restricted scheduled backup host, encrypted daily copies, dedicated backup keys and current witness sync are deferred to G-RECOVERY before customer data; prove keys absent from ordinary app/build/preview at that gate. Backup machinery is not a build kickoff prerequisite.

gates.title: Compatibility, concurrency and UI/model proof
gates.closure: Execute all named future gates against actual selected runtime and database. Auth rollback, same-tenant constraints, watermark/CAS races, current sharing, approved effects, tool usefulness, native/browser parity and negative fixtures pass.

gates.title: Before customer data
gates.closure: Before customer data, configure and prove encrypted daily DB-plus-byte copies, expiring daily snapshots, current deletion/access witness sync and the restricted scheduled backup host with recoverable scoped keys excluded from ordinary app/build/preview. Measure coherent restore for ordinary one-hour RPO/four-hour RTO, a fresh surviving accessible daily 24-hour-loss fallback, current pending/cancelled/completed deletion barriers, original seven-day copy expiry, external receipt non-replay and provider cleanup. Review privacy disclosure. During the build rely on native seven-day Neon/Tigris history; this gate does not block building the recovery producers.

gates.title: Measured scheduler load and fairness
gates.closure: Measure representative backlog and bursts across tenants and every affected job kind to identify starvation, lag and saturation. Select per-tenant fairness, concurrency/page limits, reserved security/cancellation slots and per-kind alert thresholds from those measurements; prove recovery and owed scan-tail completion across every affected kind. Until then retain finite leases, claim fences, idempotency, bounded retries, durable checkpoints, unknown-outcome reconciliation and safe operator visibility. This gate does not block building the base executor and grants no deployment or spending authority.

gates.title: Early access site go-live
gates.closure: WP-097 only: normal tests, cross-model review, reviewed access/privacy/terms copy and Sebastian approval of the Vercel preview before production. No signed evf proof. Owner ruling 2026-10-14; product workflow and before-customer-data gates remain separate. Use Vercel everyfield, new Neon everyfield-v3 and Resend; never v2 database values.

owner_product_questions.title: Chart implementation
owner_product_questions.question: Choose owned SVG components or a chart library before the shared UI package ships.
owner_product_questions.recommendation: Use small owned SVG components; add Visx only if the required chart set exceeds them.

owner_product_questions.title: Wiki editor library
owner_product_questions.owner: Knowledge editor implementor and UI designer
owner_product_questions.question: Choose Tiptap or Lexical before freezing the sanitized editor-node contract. Prove supported nodes, safe imports and organization/native editing; curated global MDX remains a separate release-validated source.
owner_product_questions.recommendation: Compare both with real supported content before WP-032. Arbitrary executable MDX round-tripping is not required.
owner_product_questions.decision_before: WP-032 editor contract; WP-035 consumes it

owner_product_questions.title: Shared sliding highlight
owner_product_questions.question: Choose one shared sliding highlight mechanism before navigation, menus and tabs consume it.
owner_product_questions.recommendation: Use an owned CSS transform mechanism first; add Motion only for a demonstrated benefit.

owner_product_questions.title: Gradient rendering cost
owner_product_questions.question: Keep CSS blur or use pre-rendered tone images after profiling the actual Overview on a low-end laptop.
owner_product_questions.recommendation: Retain the designed treatment until real profiling shows a paint problem.

owner_product_questions.title: Help center
owner_product_questions.question: Searchable Help center and how-to library are reserved for a future scope decision; retain the design.
owner_product_questions.recommendation: Keep contextual Guide WIKI-008 in v3. Authorize and assign a separate Help feature only in a future plan.

owner_product_questions.title: Marketing copy review
owner_product_questions.question: Review access, privacy and terms copy before WP-097 go-live. Review planters and trust copy before WP-049 publishes those pages; home and oversight copy is already approved.
owner_product_questions.recommendation: Approve the initial collection, retention, vendor and contact disclosures before WP-097 go-live. Keep planters/trust links hidden until their WP-049 copy review, and update product privacy before customer data.
owner_product_questions.decision_before: WP-097 go-live for access/privacy/terms; WP-049 publication for planters/trust; product privacy update before customer data.
